text:
nina: Heads-up — customers keep getting confused when saved queries show much lower counts than the console telemetry sample. How should we surface sampling when filters are composed across route-level sampling and model-level sub-sampling? :thinking:
chris: Seen this too. Quick idea: show an "Effective sample rate" badge next to the result count and a tooltip that breaks down the math (route × query).
sam: Agree. UX: show both numbers and the product, e.g. "Effective SR: 2.4% (route 8% × query 30%)". Keep it compact.
liz: UX quibble — when users compose filters across route+model, the route-level sample might not be uniform across the filtered subset. That makes a simple multiply misleading. We should compute post-filter SR.
nina: Good call. Post-filter SR is ideal, but that could be expensive for large result sets.
marco: For perf, we can return population-weighted metadata for each route and re-estimate post-filter SR client-side. Mark estimates clearly.
chris: Backend already exposes per-route sampling metadata via /api/telemetry/meta. Proposal: extend to return { population_estimate, route_sample, model_sample } so the console can calculate an estimated post-filter SR and show an "estimated" badge.
sam: API sketch (proto):
```
GET /api/telemetry/meta?route_id=foo&model=gpt-xyz
{
  "route_sample": "0.08",
  "model_sample": "0.3",
  "population_estimate": "12000"
}
```
liz: UX: show an amber indicator and tooltip when the SR is estimated. Tooltip should say: "Estimated after applying filters based on route metadata — may differ from true post-filter sampling". Add a link to docs.
nina: Rollout plan: feature behind console flag. Default to legacy behavior for two weeks while we collect help-clicks and user feedback. We should also emit telemetry events for: help_link_clicked, override_applied, and sample_badge_hover.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for telemetry/meta extension at 10:30 PST — will post status. :rocket:
chris: Engineering notes: add unit tests for meta endpoint, ensure we don’t regress latency > 50ms. Also include saved-query export contract change so exports include effective_sample_rate and breakdown.
sam: I'll take tests + small e2e to validate estimate vs exact on a synthetic dataset. nina — can you put a quick mockup in Figma? :pray:
nina: Will drop a 2-variant mock (exact vs estimated badge) into the product board in ~30m. Thanks all! :sparkles:
